Guidance & outlook: And we expect further momentum through FY '27, including incremental volumes from the pickup truck program, new platforms, and facelift programs.
With the visibility we currently have across existing programs and upcoming platforms, we remain confident in sustaining this growth momentum in the coming quarters.
But going forward to FY '28 and FY '29, and eventually our target of INR 2,000 crores of revenue, we seem to be quite early.
Growth & demand: So, this represents an 85% year-on- year growth and a 25% sequential growth over Q4 FY '26.
The transfer case business delivered strong growth during the quarter, supported by higher volumes from key OEM customers and sustained demand across upgraded platforms.
141.8 crores, registering a strong 85% year -on-year growth from Rs.
Margins & costs: Gross profit margin stood at 62.5%, broadly stable compared to 62.9% in Q1 of FY '26.

EBITDA margin improved to 29.4% compared to 24.9% in Q1 of FY '26 and 24.5% in Q4 of FY '26, supported by a favourable product mix, higher contributions from exports, and better margins from the 4x4 products.
PAT margin stood at 17.8% compared to 11.6% in Q1 of FY '26 and 13.6% in Q4 of FY '26.
Capex & expansion: First, to support our key OEM customers in their global expansion.
At the same time, we are building opportunities for the next phase of growth through new platforms, export opportunities, and expansion into adjacent transmission products.
And there are opportunities there that we are looking at supporting their plant, which is North America's and therefore the world's largest plant for transfer cases in the U.S.
Balance sheet & cash: What is particularly encouraging is that this growth has been accompanied by a significant improvement in operating leverage and profitability.
This performance is driven by a favorable product mix, increasing contribution from exports, and the operating leverage that comes from just a higher scale of business.
So, this is another area where our technology manufacturing customer relationships can create significant operating leverage as commercial volumes present themselves.
Risks & challenges: So, the opportunity also therefore presents challenges in terms of execution bandwidth.
Our E-gear drive business remained relatively subdued during the quarter.
The challenge, of course, is to now convert this into awards and awards into revenue streams.

guidance.t: But overall, with new and new projects coming up, something or the else coming up, so we can sustain a range of margin, like 20 % to 27% is a very big range.
